assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque portrait background artwork for an existing mobile farming game, Happy Farm. Generate a brand-new image; the provided carrot is ONLY a material/color style reference. Original game art, no existing franchise style or character imitation. Portrait 1:2 ratio, intended canvas 1024x2048. NO TEXT, no logo, no lettering, no buttons, no loading bar, no watermark. Reserve the upper 8%-32% as quiet uncluttered negative space for a large title logo, and bottom 74%-96% as quiet uncluttered space for a progress bar and start button. Keep important objects within center 80% horizontally so narrower screens can crop safely. Professional polished game title key art, carefully art directed, not an app icon. Direction A: immersive morning farm valley. Camera at a gently elevated angle looking into a cozy vegetable farm. Pale blue morning sky with a few soft clouds high and far away, hazy rolling green hills at horizon y=38%, a modest original terracotta-roof barn to the left at y=48%, rounded fruit tree to right, a curving path leading toward three readable vegetable garden beds with plump carrots, tomatoes and wheat in middle y=52%-70%. White picket fence helps frame scene near outer sides. Natural scene fills canvas, clear depth, fresh verdant bright colors, a small chicken near path. Bottom foreground becomes soft lightly textured grass and cream dusty path with no clutter. No giant vegetables in sky. Logo and UI will be added separately.
